author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 잡목림, 침엽수림, 혼효림에 사는 흔한 텃새이다. 혼자 또는 암수가 함께 지내다가 번식이 끝나면 다른 새들과 섞여 숲속을 돌며 먹이를 찾는다. 곤충과 거미, 여러 씨앗과 열매를 먹으며, 4~6월에 알을 7개 낳는다. 전국에 살고, 국외에서는 아무르 남부, 우수리, 만주, 일본에 분포한다.

points.ko: 머리 길이만 한 길고 곧은 부리
points.en: long straight bill, as long as the head
brown and chestnut spots on the belly sides

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 거의 같으나, 암컷은 눈선이 조금 갈색을 띠고 옆구리와 아랫배의 밤색이 옅다.

young: 어린새는 암컷과 비슷하나 윗면이 칙칙하고 갈색 기가 돌며, 눈선이 갈색이고 덜 뚜렷하고 옆구리와 아래꼬리덮깃이 짙은 밤색이 아닌 흐린 담황색이다. 다리 색도 더 옅다.

similar.how: 쇠동고비는 몸이 작고 흰 눈썹선이 뚜렷하며(수컷은 머리꼭대기가 검다), 옆구리와 아래꼬리덮깃에 밤색이 없이 아랫면이 고른 담황색이다.

art.subject: Eurasian Nuthatch (Sitta europaea), adult in winter (fresh plumage): upperparts from the crown to the uppertail coverts plain blue-grey; a bold black eye-stripe from the bill base through the eye to the side of the nape, with a thin, faint whitish line above it; chin, cheeks, ear-coverts, throat and breast white; lower breast and belly washed orange-buff; lower flanks rufous-chestnut, forming a solid dark patch at the sides of the belly; undertail coverts chestnut scaled white; central tail feathers blue-grey, outer ones black with white spots near the tip; long straight blackish bill with a paler base to the lower mandible; dark eye; grey-brown legs.
art.pose: perched on a branch in mixed woodland, searching for insects
art.scene: Korean mixed conifer and broadleaf woodland in winter; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in winter, side view perched on a branch: blue-grey upperparts, bold black eye-stripe, white cheeks, throat and breast, buff belly, rufous-chestnut lower flanks and white-scaled chestnut undertail, long straight bill

adult, side view climbing head-first down a trunk: blue-grey back, short square tail with white spots near the tips of the outer black feathers, black eye-stripe, rufous flanks, large feet gripping the bark
art.build: Small, compact, short-tailed tree-climber, about the size of a House Sparrow but stockier; big flat-crowned head with no crest, no visible neck, body held close to the bark. Bill long, straight and pointed like a chisel, about as long as the head, blackish with a paler base to the lower mandible. Legs short and strong with large feet and long claws, grey-brown. At rest the wingtips reach close to the tip of the short tail. Tail short and square. Climbs up, down and head-first along trunks and branches without using the tail as a prop.
avoid: Do not paint a long tail or show the tail pressed against the trunk like a woodpecker.
Do not paint a thin decurved bill; that is a treecreeper.
Do not paint wing bars or streaks; the upperparts are plain blue-grey.
Do not paint a black cap; that is the male Chinese Nuthatch.
Do not paint the underparts entirely orange; the throat and breast are white.
